[i]Between Luscária and Nederlandse Staat
Land Transfer RP[/i]]

[b][May 17th, 2027][/b]

[i]April 21st, 2027[/i] was a historic day for all of Erene as a Coalition of countless nations would begin to form in response to the pirates of the Dutch State. As a sympathetic observer, Luscária had begun to mobilize so as to join the Coalition.

However in recent times it has come to our attention that the Dutch State can also be considered a victim, they are victim to the plans of a rogue military commander who thought it wise to attack civilian merchant ships and the ports of Daesun. In consideration of such circumstances the Federation of Luscária has decided to give the Dutch State a chance to not just make amends, but to get the help it so desperately needs in these times.

The Federation of Luscária asks that the Dutch State take a firm stance against the colonization of South Vespurias by transferring full sovereignty and administrative control of the Royal Vespuria Colony to the Federation of Luscária, effective immediately upon ratification of this treaty.

In recognition of the Dutch States prior investments and as a demonstration of good faith, the Federation of Luscária commits to the following measures upon ratification:

[b]1.[/b] Withdraw from the Coalition against the Dutch State,

[b]2.[/b] Sign a security agreement, whereupon any military action by Luscárian Catalonia against the Dutch State shall be treated as a declaration of war against Luscária,

[b]3.[/b] Financial assistance totaling $30 billion, provided as $5 billion annually over a period of six (6) years, intended to support stabilization and recovery during this period of crisis.

[b]Signed,[/b]
[i]Caudillo Manuel A. Torres[/i]
[/spoiler]
[nation]Nederlandse staat[/nation]
[nation]Shahzada[/nation] RP

(Btw for context Luscárian Catalonia is Paldea, but we dont recognize them as Paldea, instead we only recognize them as Luscárian Catalonia.)
